_comment: Class name substrings (case-insensitive) that typically rest directly on the floor. Used by fitted_transform to selectively apply floor-contact soft constraint. Other objects (pillow, cup, book, lamp, etc.) are skipped because they sit on top of furniture rather than the floor.
_note: 'Floor-resting' here generalises to 'support-resting' — objects that sit directly on whichever ground plane the scene has (room floor, kitchen counter, table top). Includes both large furniture and kitchen-counter classes for raw_image0-style scenes.
